findings.title: Replay binds historical inference to the new process run and current policy
findings.note: Batch lines carry the run and the effective bars; v1 lines replay with run/settings NULL. Other gates (occurrence, clock, daylight, duplicate) apply under the settings in force at replay, as declared in the commit.

findings.title: Replay acknowledges dequeue progress without a durable outcome
findings.note: Explicit settle journal, retry, hold after 3 failed starts, replay idempotency on (date, time, species, source, window, correlation id). Remains: held detections are reported in the journal only (no metric or page), no transactional outbox for external posts; a crash after commit and before notifications loses those notifications.

findings.title: Shutdown persists unfiltered raw segments and neighbours despite clip privacy
findings.note: Spool keeps only the clip's sample range per recording, zero elsewhere; no neighbours on a privacy-filtered station. Clip identity across replay proven sample for sample. Not covered: support bundle, backups, live audio (OOB-13).

findings.title: Spool commit lacks complete file/directory durability and atomic checkpoint
findings.note: atomic_file::commit for every batch file, queue dir synced, 0700. Not power-cut tested (V04 needs hardware).

findings.title: Malformed replay entries and unreadable directories become skips or hidden leftovers
findings.note: Unreadable, later-format and path-escaping lines are held, never deleted; read_dir errors logged at error level; keep returns what was written.

findings.title: Duplicate interval is order-dependent and not durable
findings.note: Invariant held: no two admitted rows of one species and source within the interval in any arrival order. Not order-free (85,80,92 vs 80,85,92); that needs read-time events (decision 1, RES-18). DST fold not addressed.

findings.title: Duplicate gate mutates before storage; failed insert can suppress the next valid row
findings.note: Duplicate gate checks before and records after a successful insert.

findings.title: Privacy coverage can silently weaken when a routed classifier fails
findings.note: A window a human-capable classifier failed is privacy-unassessed and masked when the filter is on.

findings.title: Multi-model window length and score semantics are conflated
findings.note: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED by reading: per-model answer windows are already stored (process.rs:387-388); missing are a padding mask (answer window_end can pass the file end) and per-scale human/noise scores. Not implemented.

findings.title: Decoder conceals packet loss without returning validity or timing uncertainty
findings.note: Effort credited from decoded duration (probe: header 15.0 s vs 1 s decoded; ffmpeg placeholder header None). Remains: known-length lost packets are zero-filled and counted; no validity mask or timing uncertainty.

findings.title: Detection decode uses uncapped in-memory path
findings.note: CONFIRMED by reading (pipeline.rs:373 uncapped; any parseable file in the watch dir). Not implemented: refusing long files changes what an operator dropping recordings gets today; needs the batch-ingest decision (RES-05).

findings.title: Downmix can erase valid stereo content
findings.note: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED: a per-source Left/Right channel pick exists at capture (admin/audio.rs:1466, capture/process.rs:512); the averaging remains for 'both' and dropped files. Not implemented.

findings.title: Geomodel week fixed at file start even across civil boundaries
findings.note: CONFIRMED by reading (one week per file, process.rs:433-438). BirdNET-Pi parity is also per file (inferred); changing it needs a setting or an accepted parity departure. Not implemented.

findings.title: Occupancy-style export pools site detections with unrelated effort and legacy uptime
findings.note: A detection makes an occasion detected only on a source that surveyed it; &source= scopes the history. Remains: survey-design export, interval-union effort for declared co-located sites, DST-aware occasions, vocabulary eligibility.

findings.title: Detection row and per-model answer evidence are not atomically coupled
findings.note: Row and answers in one transaction (answers in a savepoint). No red test: the crash window cannot be hit deterministically without a fault-injecting VFS.

findings.title: A backlog detection marks capture source up, irrespective of current capture
findings.note: Replayed detections no longer stamp source up. A live backlog file still stamps; the supervisor rewrites the gauge each tick (2 s default).

findings.title: WAL NORMAL intentionally sacrifices committed data durability under power loss
findings.note: Opt-in DB_SYNCHRONOUS=full, default unchanged, loss window documented. Power-loss behaviour not measured (V04).

findings.title: A failed later inference window discards all earlier successful predictions in a file
findings.note: Failed windows keep the rest of the file; failed share not credited as effort.

findings.title: Exports join a run-level model hash rather than each answer’s artifact
findings.note: Migration 67 records each classifier per run; exports resolve (run_id, model_id); ambiguous legacy runs export no checksum. Remains: CSV confidence still 4 decimals (JSON is full precision); per-answer artefacts in the model-scores export.

findings.title: Mirror credentials appear in model fetch logs and errors
findings.note: Mirror credentials redacted from every log line and error of the model download.

findings.title: Model staging durability and bundle-level activation need cross-path proof
findings.note: Directory fsync via atomic_file::commit at all four placements. Mixed-generation hypothesis REJECTED by reading (per-file pin hash before rename; model then labels).

findings.title: Mutation gate was not fully green in last inspected mutation run
findings.note: ffmpeg job annotated, model.rs shards 70->80 min; check-ci-config.py passes locally (durations not readable here). The [3/3] job's own failure (log 404) is unexplained. Needs a mutation run on the integrated head.
